r.summary:
Market research, checked live on 2026-09-27 on Etsy, eBay, Amazon, TikTok Shop and seller sites. Unless noted, prices are single-unit US retail.

(1) Other 3D-printed plastic car keychains cluster at $10–15. On Etsy and seller sites the examples are AltezzaCustoms at $12 + $5.50 shipping, KeyCharmCustoms at $12.65 shipped free, GreanlandOffroad at $10.95 shipped free for a multi-colour PETG piece, a Honda Del Sol keychain at $15 + $5.58, Race Ready Designs at $10 and CarChains3D at $15 stock or $25 custom. Full-colour custom replicas cost $44.99–70.

(2) eBay is the cheap end: $1.99–14.99 plus about $5.38–8.60 shipping. Unit counts are low. Examples: 10–39 sold at $9.99–12 + $6.07 from one seller, and 54 sold at $1.99 + $5.50 from another.

(3) The closest direct competitor is enamel/metal car-front keychains, which are the same concept. They sell at $12.99–$25 on Etsy, usually with free shipping or free shipping over $35. Examples: SupraCharms BMW M3 G80 at $17.99 and GT3 RS at $15.99, InjectedDesigns E92 M3 at $18.95, DriftPins Mustang S550 at $12.99 + $5.50, CarPinCollection C8 at $15.95 + $6.07, and a Lamborghini Revuelto at $25. These shops have the strongest demand signals: 6.6k–14.8k shop sales, up to 291 reviews on one item, and 17–20+ shoppers with the item in their cart.

(4) Officially licensed keychains run $7.49–$29.99 on Amazon and Etsy. The Ford oval enamel keychain shows 500+ bought per month, and a licensed C8 die-cut is $24.99. Car-maker shop keyrings run about €45–$177.

(5) TikTok Shop and Amazon car keychains are mostly mass-market zinc, leather or PVC at $1.33–$14.99. The volume leaders show 1.3K sold at $10.39 and 105 sold at $14.99. No publicly visible 3D-printed car-front listings turned up on TikTok Shop.

(6) Upcharges seen:
- Colour: +$1–2 for non-black colours, "custom colours" +$0–3 in one guide.
- Glow headlights: +$6.
- Custom headlights or multi-colour paint: +$10 ($15 to $25 at CarChains3D).
- Gift box: +$8–9.
- Personalisation: +$2–5.

(7) Bundles seen:
- Craft-fair guide ladder: 1 for $7, 2 for $12, 3 for $15.
- 35% off 4 items at one Etsy shop.
- Free shipping at $35+ at DriftPins and CarPinCollection.
- "Save up to 20%" multi-buy on eBay.

(8) Wholesale and events. Standard wholesale ("keystone") pricing is 50% of retail; consignment pays the maker 50–70% of retail after the item sells. Craft-fair and vendor guides put keychains at $5–15, with "$8 keychains" as a sign example. I found no car-meet-specific price data because Reddit and TikTok pages were blocked, so car-meet pricing is my estimate only.

(9) The market is crowded: Etsy lists 5,000+ items under "3d printed car keychains". Plastic 3D-printed specific-model listings are scarce. Two of the three I found by search were unavailable when opened. Several sellers use "Keychain FOR BMW" / "Fits Porsche" wording.

Derived estimate (low confidence): list at $12–15 plus about $5.50 shipping, or about $15–18 with free shipping. At car meets, about $10 each or 3 for $25. Custom body colour +$2–3; wholesale about $6–7.50.

Anything not confirmed on a live page is marked low or medium confidence.

r.summary:
Research on production costs for 2-colour PLA car keychains printed on a Creality K2 Combo, US pricing as of late September 2026.

**Filament**
- Creality Hyper PLA costs $19.99/kg for a single spool (sale price; $32.99 list).
- Buying in bulk brings it down to $13.25–15.99/kg:
  - store tiers: 5 spools at $16.99 each, 10 at $15.99, 20 at $14.99
  - 4 kg pack for $62.99
  - 12 kg pack for $159
- Other good PLA:
  - Bambu PLA Basic refill: about $19.99/kg
  - Elegoo: about $12.59/kg single spool, about $10/kg in bundles
  - Sunlu: $13.99/kg single, about $9.75/kg in 4 kg bundles
  - Polymaker Panchroma: $12.49–16.66/kg
- The average across 6,508 tracked PLA listings is $20.68/kg.
- At 8 g per keychain, filament is roughly $0.11–0.16 before purge waste.

**Machine**
- Creality store prices: K2 $399, K2 Combo with CFS $549 (Best Buy also $549; one Amazon deal was $584).
- I found no K2-specific figure for useful life. General guides give 3,000–10,000 print hours, with about 5,000 h a common assumption. Depreciation on the $549 combo:
  - about $0.055–0.18 per printer-hour, $0.11 at 5,000 h
  - about $0.02–0.08 per keychain at 20–30 printer-minutes

**Power**
- I found no measured watt reading for the base K2. The closest data points:
  - K1: measured about 100 W while printing, 370 W peak while heating, 20 W idle
  - Bambu P1S: 0.1 kWh per hour on PLA
  - K2 Plus: 220 W average, a spec-derived figure for a bigger machine with an active chamber heater
- Estimate for the K2 on PLA: about 100–150 W (low confidence).
- US residential electricity: EIA average was 18.31¢/kWh in July 2026 (17.45¢ in July 2025). By state it runs from about 13¢ (Nevada) to about 53¢ (Hawaii).
- Electricity is only about $0.01 per keychain, which is negligible.

**Consumables and failures**
- K2 Unicorn quick-swap 0.4 mm nozzle: $9.98 each, or $37.92 for a 4-nozzle kit. With PLA, brass nozzles last about 3–6 months or 400–600 h; hardened steel lasts a year or more.
- K2 PEI double-sided plate: $17.99 (volume discounts down to $13.99 each). Users report 1,250–5,000+ printing hours per plate.
- I found no K2 OEM belt price.
- Real consumable wear works out to about $0.01–0.03 per printer-hour. One generic guide uses $0.10–0.40/h for all maintenance, which is much more conservative.
- Failure rates:
  - print farms: 2–5%
  - experienced users: 3–8%
  - intermediate users: 8–15%
  - beginners: 15–25%
  - Prusa's own multi-material testing: 7%
- The stock K2 CFS firmware does a fixed purge of about 100 mm (about 0.3 g, my calculation) on every filament change, plus 5 nozzle wipes. For black-and-white parts that change colour many times, this waste can matter.

**Key rings and packaging, per unit in bulk**
| Item | Per unit |
|---|---|
| 25 mm split ring | $0.042 (at 1,000) to $0.18 (at 100) |
| Ring with chain and jump ring | about $0.10–0.17 |
| 2x3 in zip bag, 2 mil | $0.0045–0.015 |
| Kraft keychain backing card | about $0.12–0.18 |
| Printed thank-you card | about $0.048–0.058 |
| 6x9 poly mailer | $0.029 (per 1,000) to $0.17 (per 100) |
| 4x8 #000 bubble mailer | about $0.10–0.11 |

**Caveats**
- Several store pages could not be fetched or showed sale pricing, and Creality's "sale" prices appear to be the everyday price.
- I found no price for 3x4 bags.
- Derived per-keychain costs and the K2 wattage are my estimates, marked low confidence.

r.summary:
SELLING FEES, SHIPPING AND IP RISK FOR 2-COLOUR PLA CAR-FRONT KEYCHAINS (US, researched Sept 2026)

FEES. On Etsy a roughly $12 keychain costs about $1.59 in fees per sale (13%): a $0.20 listing fee, 6.5% transaction fee on item plus shipping, and 3% + $0.25 payment processing. If the sale came through an Offsite Ad, add 15%, which makes it about $3.39 (28%). Shops under $10k a year in sales can opt out of Offsite Ads. Shops over $10k pay 12%, participation becomes mandatory, and the fee is capped at $100 per order. Share & Save refunds 4% on sales you bring in with your own link. Some new shops pay a one-time setup fee of $15-29.
Other platforms on the same $12 sale:
- eBay: 13.6% + $0.40, about $2.03.
- Amazon Handmade: 15% (minimum $0.30), about $1.80. The Professional plan is waived after the first month.
- TikTok Shop: 6%, about $0.72, with payment processing included. TikTok's own page confirms 6%. Several August 2026 blogs claim a rise to 8% from Aug 4, 2026, but I could not confirm this officially.
- Shopify: $29-39 a month plus 2.9% + $0.30, about $0.65 a sale plus the monthly fee.

SHIPPING. A tracked USPS Ground Advantage label for a keychain in a #000 bubble mailer is the realistic option.
- From Etsy, eBay or Pirate Ship labels, a 4 oz parcel to a normal address costs about $5.50-6.40 (Shippo example: $5.97). A mailer adds about $0.11-0.25.
- Since July 12, 2026, rural ZIPs, Alaska, Hawaii, Puerto Rico and military addresses are charged the 15.99 oz price: $6.93-8.40.
- At the post office counter (retail) it costs $7.90-9.45.
- An 8% temporary surcharge runs from Apr 26, 2026 to Jan 17, 2027.
- A stamped letter costs $0.82 + $0.49 nonmachinable surcharge = $1.31 at 1 oz ($1.60 at 2 oz). It has no tracking, and the piece must stay under 1/4 inch thick. USPS rules name rigid pieces and items like keys that make a piece uneven as nonmachinable.
- Flats (large envelopes) must be flexible and evenly thick, so a rigid keychain is charged as a parcel. eBay Standard Envelope does not cover keychains.
- Etsy's 2026 Purchase Protection requires tracking or an Etsy label (with some exceptions for letters). This makes Ground Advantage the safe default.

IP AND TRADEMARK RISK. This is the biggest risk.
- Etsy removes listings when a rights owner files a report. Counter-notices only work for copyright. For a trademark takedown the seller has to contact the complainant, and repeat reports can close the shop. In 2024 Etsy received 85,591 IP reports, removed about 832,000 listings and closed about 26,500 shops for IP or counterfeit violations.
- Ford, GM, FCA, Jaguar Land Rover and DeLorean have published eBay VeRO profiles. eBay can remove listings and restrict or suspend accounts.
- Mercedes-Benz removed over 212,000 listings in 2024.
- BMW and Amazon won a 2023-24 lawsuit in Spain over counterfeit BMW-logo key rings.
- SHELBY and GT-500 are registered trademarks of Carroll Shelby Licensing. Mustang is Ford's, and a third-party trademark notice says Ford also claims the Mustang's vehicle shapes.
- Car shapes alone can be protected trade dress even with no logo. Ferrari won against body-shape replicas in 1991. In GM v. Lanard Toys (2006), a toy Humvee maker lost and paid an 8% royalty ($340k) plus over $900k in profits.
- Nominative fair use only allows the minimum brand reference needed, with nothing implying endorsement. A blog source says "inspired by" disclaimers do not protect you. eBay's search manipulation policy bans unrelated keywords and comparisons with other brands.
- Common ways to lower the risk:
  - Leave out logos, badges and model text.
  - Keep brand names and model names such as GT500 out of titles and tags.
  - Use generic descriptions, such as "1960s American muscle car front."
  - Or apply for the official licensing programs (GM licensing, Ford Global Brand Licensing).
- None of these makes a car-shaped design completely safe.

Also: marketplaces collect US sales tax for you. The federal 1099-K threshold is back to $20,000 and 200 transactions from 2025. Etsy's own fee and IP pages returned 403 errors, so Etsy numbers come from recent third-party guides and search snippets of Etsy help pages, which all agree. TikTok's rate is the least certain number here.

checked.summary:
I re-checked the main cost and price numbers on 2026-09-27. Most of the earlier research holds up. Six things needed correcting or adding.

**Corrections**

1. **Creality bulk filament deals are sold out.** The Hyper PLA 4 kg ($62.99), 12 kg ($159) and 4-pack ($59.99) listings all show "Sold Out". The $13.25–15.75/kg figures are therefore not available today. What you can actually buy:
   - 1 spool: $19.99 (list $32.99)
   - 5 spools: $16.99 each
   - 10 spools: $15.99 each
   - 20 spools: $14.99 each
   - The RFID version, which the CFS reads automatically, is $21.00.

2. **Filament per keychain was understated.** The earlier $0.09–0.18 figure ignored the filament wasted on every colour change, which is the biggest filament cost on a multi-colour keychain.
   - The stock K2 firmware purges a fixed ~100 mm (about 0.3 g) on every CFS filament swap. The slicer's own flush comes on top of that.
   - One K2 Plus forum user said a small 4-colour model needed "18x more filament" than expected because of flushing. A K2 guide estimates 30–40% waste on 4-colour prints with frequent changes.
   - Purge waste per plate stays about the same however many keychains are on it, so batching spreads it out.
   - Use 1–3 g of waste per keychain when printing 8–12 per plate, and 5–15 g for a single one-off. This is my estimate, not a measured figure. Take the real number from the slicer's flush estimate.

3. **Printer price.** K2 Combo $549 (shown as $699 regular) and K2 $399 ($549 regular) are confirmed on the Creality store. Reviews from October 2025 quote $799 for the Combo, which is stale.

4. **Printer power draw.** Still no measured figure for the base K2. The specs are confirmed: 70 W hotend, 100 °C max bed, no chamber heater. My estimate of about 100–150 W stands, based on the K1, which measured about 100 W while printing. Electricity works out to about $0.02–0.03 per printer-hour, which is negligible.

5. **Shipping.** The July 12, 2026 change is confirmed. USPS's published commercial Ground Advantage price for anything under 1 lb is now the 15.999 oz price: $6.93–8.40.
   - eBay, Pirate Ship and Shippo still charge by the ounce for addresses in the lower 48 that are not rural: about $5.50–6.36 at 4 oz. Etsy labels probably work the same way; one guide says so, but I could not confirm it.
   - Rural ZIPs, Alaska, Hawaii, Puerto Rico and military addresses pay $6.93–8.40.
   - A stamped letter or large envelope is not valid for a rigid keychain.

6. **Labour was missing from the model.** Add it. Prusa's cost method counts about 5–10 minutes of handling per job.

**Confirmed as stated**
- US electricity: 18.31¢/kWh (EIA, July 2026).
- Etsy fees: $0.20 listing fee (charged again on each sale), 6.5% transaction fee on item plus shipping, and 3% + $0.25 processing on the total including sales tax. Offsite Ads take 15% (12% once the shop passes $10k in sales), capped at $100 per order.
- eBay: 13.6% + $0.30/$0.40 per order.
- USPS counter prices: $7.90–9.45.

**Competitor prices**
- Etsy and eBay blocked my requests (HTTP 403), so I could not re-open those listings. Their prices remain medium confidence.
- I did confirm these on the sellers' own sites: CarChains3D $15 (now sold out), Race Ready Designs $10, and DriftPins' enamel Mustang S550 at $12.99.
- An Etsy search snippet showed multicolour printing as +$6 for small and +$12 for larger sizes.

**Recommended model inputs**
| Input | Value |
|---|---|
| Filament price | $0.020/g ($19.99/kg), or $0.016/g if buying 10 spools |
| Keychain weight | 8–15 g, taken from the slicer |
| Colour-change waste | 1–3 g per keychain when batched |
| Failures | 10% extra on filament and ring |
| Key ring (ring, chain and jump ring) | $0.15 |
| Packaging (#000 bubble mailer, backing card, bag, thank-you card) | $0.40 |
| Printer wear | $0.11/h depreciation ($549 over 5,000 h) + $0.03/h maintenance + $0.024/h power (0.13 kW at $0.183) = about $0.165/h |
| Printer time | about 0.3–0.4 h per keychain when batched |
| Labour | 6 min at $20/h = $2.00 |
| Shipping label | $6.00 average ($5.50–6.36 normal addresses, up to $8.40 rural) |

**Worked example.** Materials, printer time and packaging come to about $1.00 per keychain. Selling on Etsy at $19.99 with free shipping:
- Costs: $1.00 materials + $2.00 labour + $6.00 label + $2.39 Etsy fees.
- Profit: about $8.60, or 43% of the price.
- If the sale comes through an Offsite Ad, the extra 15% takes profit down to about $5.60.

**Recommended prices**
- Etsy: $19.99 with free shipping, or $13.99–14.99 + $5.99 shipping.
- Car meets: $10–12 each, or 3 for $25–30.
- Custom body colour: +$0–2, since swapping filament costs you almost nothing.
- Wholesale: $7–8.
